# awacino_member (Resource)

A member of the Awacino company account: a company-owned Awacino account for one person, with its first invitation code. The person pastes the code into the Awacino app (or opens `join_url`) and signs in with Apple, Google or Microsoft. Each active member or open invitation takes one user seat.

Destroying the resource **offboards** the member: every session and live connection ends, the member's Beam-in codes move to the company, their Beam-out devices leave the company and the seat is freed. The person's private Awacino account is not touched.

Needs the key section **Users** (Write).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A new employee. role "read" = uses only the devices you grant (awacino_access_grant).
resource "awacino_member" "dieter" {
  email        = "dieter@company.example"
  display_name = "Dieter Muster"
  external_id  = "4711" # employee number - `terraform import awacino_member.dieter external_id:4711`
  role         = "read"

  # Awacino mails the invitation (in German). Without this block, send join_url in your own mail.
  send_invitation = {
    days   = 7
    locale = "de"
  }
}

output "dieter_join_url" {
  value     = awacino_member.dieter.join_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The invited address. Changing it replaces the member (offboard + new invitation).

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) `false` deactivates the member (sessions and live connections end, the seat is freed); `true` reactivates (needs a free seat).
- `can_agentic` (Boolean) Role `read` only: may use agentic AI (default `false`). Members with role `user` or `auditor` always have it (`true`).
- `can_automation` (Boolean) Role `read` only: may use automation (default `false`). Members with role `user` or `auditor` always have it (`true`).
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the app (up to 120 characters).
- `external_id` (String) Your own id for the member (for example the employee number), unique per company. `terraform import awacino_member.x external_id:<value>` finds the member by it.
- `role` (String) `read` (default - uses only the devices you grant), `user`, or `auditor` (audit log only; needs the Compliance package). An API key cannot create ADMIN accounts.
- `send_invitation` (Attributes) Awacino mails the invitation to `email`. Without this block the code is created as well but not mailed - send `join_url` in your own mail. Only used when the member is created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--send_invitation))

### Read-Only

- `accepted_at` (String) When the person joined.
- `created_at` (String) When the member was created.
- `id` (String) Member id.
- `invitation_code` (String, Sensitive) The first invitation code (`AWA-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`). Known only right after the member was created; keep your state in an encrypted backend. Use `awacino_invitation` for a new code.
- `invitation_expires_at` (String) When the open invitation ends (null once the member has joined).
- `join_url` (String, Sensitive) `https://www.awacino.com/join/#<code>` for your own mail (the code is in the fragment and never reaches a server log). Known only on create.
- `status` (String) `invited`, `active` or `deactivated`.

<a id="nestedatt--send_invitation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `send_invitation`

Optional:

- `days` (Number) Days the code is valid (1-14, default 7).
- `locale` (String) Mail language, ISO 639-1 (`en`, `de`, `nb`, `pt`, ...). Default `en`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By member id
terraform import awacino_member.dieter 1234

# By your external_id
terraform import awacino_member.dieter external_id:4711
```
